name: SIQ - Trending Products
description: Scroll-animated trending products section with a curtain-split heading effect. Two heading words start centered and slide apart like a curtain as the user scrolls, revealing a product grid that grows from behind. Light background, fully scroll-bound and reversible. Configurable heading, font family, animation style (scroll or none), product collection, image ratio, spacing, and colors. Perfect for hero-style featured collections.
author: SectionIQ
